sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5 clean background painting for a jigsaw game,1280x1600. A leather-working bench with a half-finished travel bag, gently elevated three-quarter close view. Dominant warm TERRACOTTA and chestnut leather across the large bag, rolls of hide and workbench mat, ivory stitching and small brass tools, muted olive accents. Rich dimensional storybook digital painting with tactile leather grain, rounded well-used wooden tools, soft upper-left window light and beautifully separated shapes. Generic craft workshop with no destination, city, recognizable landmark, people, lettering, numbers, logos or UI border. A substantial saddle-colored travel bag in the center, spools, awl, brass buckles, a folded cloth and small pottery cup at the sides. Finished clean plate for five later independently painted moving parts: omit one dangling leather zipper pull at upper-right bag opening, one loose tied linen thread loop on the front seam, a narrow hanging paper tag on the bag handle, a small leafy herb sprig in the pottery cup and one thin loose leather strip on the bench front. Keep seams, handle, cup and complete underlying surfaces intact; no white holes or rectangular gaps. Detailed inviting hand-painted artisan scene, not photorealistic photography or a flat vector.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite atlas for a warm, detailed hand-painted travel jigsaw. Genuine transparent RGBA background, absolutely no colored backdrop, no haze, no glow, no drop-shadow halo. Landscape 1536x1024. Invisible 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512x512. Five independent objects, sixth lower-right cell completely empty. Each whole object must fit inside the central 300x300 pixels of its cell with at least 100px fully transparent padding on every side. Objects MUST NOT touch cell boundaries. No drawn grid, no labels or text, no ground surfaces. Crisp painted texture, natural light upper left, thin clean alpha edges. Paint exactly these five objects, one per cell in reading order: (1) a cognac leather zipper pull on a tiny brass ring, hanging vertically; (2) a loose ivory linen sewing-thread loop with two short trailing ends, seen from above, no spool; (3) a small blank cream luggage tag on a thin tan cord loop, hanging vertically, no writing; (4) a green rosemary sprig with thin bare lower stem; (5) a short curled chestnut leather offcut strip viewed three-quarter from above. For a terracotta leatherworker's bench with travel bag. Natural textured painterly objects, no logos.

sources.name: surface-atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game cutout atlas with exactly TWO small loose objects resting flat on a workbench, warm hand-painted textured style, upper-left sunlight. Transparent RGBA, no background or visible table surface. 1536x1024 canvas, invisible 3x2 grid of 512x512 cells. Only top-left and top-middle cells contain an object; all other four cells empty. Objects entirely within central 300x240 area of each cell with huge transparent margins. Top-left: a loose coil of fine ivory linen sewing thread, lying FLAT viewed at a low three-quarter tabletop angle so the loop is a horizontally wide ELLIPSE, long axis horizontal, two tiny trailing loose ends. Fine fiber texture, not thick rope. Top-middle: one short thin chestnut leather offcut strip LYING FLAT with one end only slightly curling upward, also viewed at same low three-quarter tabletop angle, horizontal shape not tall. Include subtle warm semitransparent tight CONTACT SHADOW directly beneath each object, but no table material or rectangular background and no ambient halo. Not floating; believable contact with the eventual table. No text, labels, drawn grid, borders or additional objects.
